description: Paid ($0.002 USDC on Base, x402). Latest value for a key, with its chain entry. Agent memory: read the latest value for a key from the paying wallet's persistent key-value store, with its signed hash-chain entry. Reads keep working through the 90-day grace period after the term ends. A missing key returns 404 and is not charged.. Charged only if it succeeds. Call once without payment to get the price, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].
